title: When did the idea of an inland capital begin?
hook: Brasília opened in 1960, but the idea was almost two centuries old.
summary: The idea dates from colonial times; the 1891 Constitution set land aside on the Planalto Central, and the Cruls Mission marked it out.

cardBlocks.text: Moving the capital away from the coast is a much older idea than Brasília. It first appeared in colonial times, under the Marquis of Pombal, returned with the arrival of the royal family, and gained strength with figures such as Hipólito José da Costa and José Bonifácio, who argued for moving it to Paracatu, in Minas Gerais.

It only became law under the Republic. The 1891 Constitution, the first of the Republic, gave the federal government a 14,400-square-kilometre area on the Planalto Central, the central plateau, to be marked out for a future capital. In 1892, President Floriano Peixoto set up a commission to do that, led by the Belgian astronomer Luiz Cruls, director of Rio de Janeiro’s Observatory.
The idea of an inland capital dates from colonial times; in 1891 the Constitution set the site aside on the central plateau.

deepDiveBlocks.text: The Exploring Commission of the Central Plateau left Rio on 9 June 1892 with 22 men and about 10 tonnes of baggage. From 1892 to 1894, the team studied the region’s climate, terrain, rivers, wildlife, plants and the way its people lived.
The result was the Cruls Report, published in 1894. It described a place with fertile soil, a healthy climate and plenty of drinking water.
A capital on the coast was seen as unsafe and exposed to diseases that arrived through the ports. Moving the government inland was also a way to unite the country and settle its interior.

support.excerpt: Fica pertencendo à União, no planalto central da República, uma zona de 14.400 quilômetros quadrados, que será oportunamente demarcada para nela estabelecer-se a futura Capital Federal.
O que poucos sabem, no entanto, é que essa transferência já estava prevista na Constituição de 1891, a primeira da República.

Por meio da Portaria 114-A, Floriano Peixoto criou a Comissão Exploradora do Planalto Central.

claims.text: The commission was led by the Belgian astronomer Luiz Cruls, director of Rio de Janeiro’s Observatory, and was to mark out the 14,400 km² area.

support.excerpt: Escolheram como chefe da comissão Louis Cruls, professor da Escola Superior Militar e diretor do Observatório Astronômico do Rio de Janeiro, atual Observatório Nacional.
Chefiados pelo astrônomo e geógrafo belga Louis Ferdinand Cruls
A missão principal da comissão era definir no Planalto Central um quadrilátero de 14.400 quilômetros quadrados.

claims.text: The commission left Rio on 9 June 1892 with 22 men and about 10 tonnes of baggage.

support.excerpt: Na manhã de 9 de junho de 1892, 22 homens partiram do Rio de Janeiro rumo a Goiás. Eles levavam 206 caixotes e fardos (cerca de 10 toneladas)

claims.text: From 1892 to 1894, the team studied the climate, terrain, rivers, wildlife, plants and the way local people lived.

support.excerpt: De 1892 a 1894, eles fizeram estudos científicos até então inéditos no Centro-Oeste, mapeando aspectos climáticos e topográficos, além de estudar a fauna, a flora, os cursos de rios e modo de vida dos habitantes.

claims.text: The Cruls Report, published in 1894, described fertile soil, a healthy climate and plenty of drinking water.

support.excerpt: Foram sete meses de estudos, que resultaram no Relatório Cruls, publicado em 1894.
